capabilities.label: Echo Edge Layer
capabilities.role: Fast interaction edge layer, voice, IoT, approvals and controlled fallback.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Echo is operational but is not the main brain of Zavorth.
limitations: Some physical adapters depend on local environment and user credentials.
capabilities.nextStep: Keep Echo as edge/fallback and prevent it from becoming a parallel cognitive runtime.

capabilities.label: Nexus Surface
capabilities.role: Modern converged Surface/API for AgentGateway, Fabric and Echo fallback.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Nexus has no HTTP stack or separate brain; /api/v2/nexus/* is a converged alias.
limitations: Nexus should be presented as a modern surface, not as a separate runtime.
capabilities.nextStep: Use Nexus as the official central runtime entry point when UX needs a modern API.

capabilities.label: Browser MCP
capabilities.role: Browser automation via MCP with doctor and isolation for arbitrary scripts.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: AutomaticBrowserTool is real; arbitrary JS in the local browser remains blocked without an isolated sidecar.
capabilities.publicStatus: needs configuration when browser stack is not ready
limitations: Hosts without Playwright/Chromium provisioned need to run the doctor and provision the stack.
Arbitrary JS scripts require an isolated sidecar.
capabilities.nextStep: Keep doctor and sidecar as conditions for advanced use.

capabilities.label: local Voice Dictation
capabilities.role: local transcription via whisper.cpp when binary and model are provisioned.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Does not return synthetic transcription; fails with a traceable error when the environment is not ready.
capabilities.publicStatus: needs microphone, binary and model configuration
limitations: Continuous capture depends on an external worker via ZAVORTH_VOICE_MIC_COMMAND.
local whisper depends on binary and model configured by the user.
capabilities.nextStep: Create guided provisioning for microphone worker and local model.

capabilities.label: Official Swarm v2
capabilities.role: Official multi-role executor with queues/batches, persistent role library, replay, metrics and per-worker isolation.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Swarm v2 is the official surface at /api/web/gateway/swarm-v2; /experimental/swarm-v2 remains only as a legacy alias.
limitations: Temp-worktree isolation separates cwd by role; stronger OS isolation should use approved docker, WSL, or external sandbox profiles.
capabilities.nextStep: Expandir profiles de worker por ambiente real without remover batch queue, receipts e approval boundary.

capabilities.label: Session V2 PTY
capabilities.role: V2 PTY/WebSocket session for interactive terminal and advanced observability.
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Exists in experimental routes and does not replace the canonical session.
limitations: Official UI and full ownership are not yet promoted as the primary flow.
capabilities.nextStep: Promote only after official UX, cleanup, timeout and replay.

capabilities.label: Session Recorder DVR
capabilities.runtimeTruth: Recorder captures the v2 flow, but official replay is not yet the primary surface.
limitations: Dedicated dashboard replay still needs formal promotion.
capabilities.nextStep: Complete official player/replay before shipping as production DVR.
